use_case_summary: Support agent automation for billing flows: conversational assistants that retrieve invoices, initiate refunds, propose plan changes and emit structured JSON to downstream systems (CRM, billing). Must support streaming tokens for agent UI and function/tool calls to Stripe + Zuora with strict schema outputs.
technical_requirements: streaming responses with <300ms incremental token latency target
function/tool calling: call Stripe (charge_lookup, refund_create) and Zuora (subscription_change)
structured JSON outputs validated against provided schema
audit logging per request with retention policy control
ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback to smaller model variants
